title: Hopelessness in Cinema
intro: Some films don't offer you a way out. They just sit beside you in the dark and breathe.

films.title: Requiem for a Dream
films.line: Four souls chase small dreams until the wanting swallows them whole.

films.title: Dancer in the Dark
films.line: A mother holds onto music as the world strips everything else away.

films.title: Oldboy
films.line: Fifteen years of rage leads a man toward a truth he cannot survive.

films.title: The Road
films.line: A father and son walk through ash and silence searching for any reason to continue.

films.title: Prisoners
films.line: Desperation turns a grieving man into something he no longer recognises in the mirror.

films.title: Come and See
films.line: A boy enters the forest with bright eyes and emerges carrying something that never leaves.

films.title: I Saw the Devil
films.line: Revenge becomes a ritual that slowly hollows out the one performing it.

films.title: Melancholia
films.line: Two sisters face the end of everything in the most quietly devastating way imaginable.
